verdict.rationale: Unit's API docs exist: an 'Explore the API' link and a /docs/api/webhooks page. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference or runnable examples such as a try-it console or sandbox playground. The OpenAPI and docs-markdown probes returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec that could back an interactive explorer. A static API reference is adjacent to this story and does not deliver it.
